decisions.method_note: Actual material/profile evidence controls selection. Photo illumination and white balance are unknown; small aerial ROIs have compression and shadow. Colour metrics describe these pixels only.

zones.actual_evidence: Red brick-looking masonry with visible coursed wall character; no written product specification.
zones.reason: Brick bond and mortar are directly consistent with the observed construction character. A tiny lit gable ROI ranks polished granite slightly closer in colour, but it lacks brick bond; semantic evidence therefore controls. Use one coherent brick field with native lighting, not red/brown patchwork.

alternatives.reason: Warm coursed alternative, but the broad brown bond is less consistent with the visible red brick wall and existing correction already rejects the generic mud-brick envelope.
Lit-ROI colour is marginally closer (DeltaE00 14.347 versus bricks 15.233), but its stone speckle contradicts the observed brick courses.

zones.zone: steep main roof and dormer roof skins
zones.actual_evidence: Dark blue-gray overlapping small-unit roof; exact product unresolved.
zones.reason: The original texture has an overlapping tiled reading and full construction shape family. Against the 18x14-pixel roof ROI it scores DeltaE00 raw/equal-L 9.701/9.444. Gray concrete scores 7.491/7.132 but is flat, lacks the observed unit pattern and supplies no stair/slab family.
zones.alternative: minecraft:gray_concrete only if used for an unavoidable flat hidden backing surface, not the visible pitched skin.

zones.zone: pale dormer fronts, cheeks, eaves and small sash framing
zones.actual_evidence: Pale painted-looking trim is directly visible at the two north dormers; substrate and lower-wall trim colour are unresolved.
zones.reason: Coherent pale construction family with thin shapes. Apply confidently to dormers/eaves and provisionally to lower apertures; do not transfer it into a broad white wall field.

dormer_raster_refinement.scope: Only authored dormer pixels with one cardinal neighbor in the front 0.55 m; restore the unchanged measured source face underneath. This removes a raster finger, not a measured building portion.
dormer_raster_refinement.reason: The v6 native northeast view showed a half-metre quartz finger obscuring one complete glazed front. Preserve the packet rectangles, eaves, ridges, placement and measured source roof.
dormer_raster_refinement.pointed_front_cap_rule: Only the narrow front raster receives paired inward-rising quartz stairs. Their common physical top is the largest whole-block height at or below the unchanged packet ridge: 75.50 m north and 76.00 m south. Full quartz heads below the stair base close the glass. Quantified per-column top deltas and the two omitted spurs are mandatory in the study audit.
dormer_raster_refinement.compact_pale_rake: Use original quantized gable profile, dark deepslate cheeks and only source-shaped front roof caps in quartz. Preserve bounds, centroids, eaves and ridges.

facade_plane_refinement.purpose: Use the measured footprint segments as straight facade planes and treat block-by-block zigzags along each segment as voxelization, not pilasters or bays.

segments_uv_m.treatment: One continuous flat brick facade. Remove the native baseline's repeated full-height raster teeth with inward-backed brick stair/slab shaping.
One continuous straight segment after the intentional approximately 0.91 m setback at U about 12.72 m. Smooth its voxel steps independently; preserve the setback return.
Straight short facade belonging to the measured low western appendage. Smooth only along this segment and preserve its bounding returns.
One continuous flat brick facade. Remove repeated raster teeth while preserving endpoints and the west/east measured returns.

intentional_geometry_to_preserve: The approximately 0.91 m north setback/return between the north_main and north_east_setback_plane segments near U=12.72 m.
The measured western low appendage and its short returns around U=0.0-3.12 m.
The irregular east end and all source-footprint corners.
Dormer, roof and trim silhouettes; they do not define wall-plane projections.
facade_plane_refinement.bounded_method: Keep every facade cell inside the measured footprint. Shape only the outward half of voxel-step cells with brick stairs/slabs, with solid brick backing on the interior side. Do not fill to a replacement rectangle, move the centerline, or repeat a return vertically as an architectural projection.

refinement_notes: Use the minimal regular solid nearest-cell grid raster of each measured straight plane; v9 stair combing was rejected in native views. No change to measured orientation, footprint or real north setback.
Gray panes are tonal proxies for dark source apertures; all hidden openings retain existing proposed positions.
Continuous dark roof edge replaces exaggerated alternating white caps; source fine fascia is sub-voxel.
North windows shorten to three pane rows inside unchanged dormer bounds/eaves/ridges. South fronts remain compact consistency proposals.
Two-row pale gable triangles above gray north panes restore the observed tonal hierarchy. Pale material is confined to the most outward front row at each world X, while sloped cheeks remain dark.
